Payload below fragmentation threshold, always-connected topology, no offline custody or restart scope.

Reuse infrastructure, identify exact missing seams, then present concrete implementation scope for approval before multi-file code changes per AGENTS.md. Homogeneous baselines aid diagnosis. Evidence names actual stack entrypoints, topology, commands, revision and observed outcomes; existing trace links reconciled.
